# TruLot
# https://trulot.com
# Updated: 2026-08-21

TruLot is a parcel and property intelligence company.

TruLot is building a new way to connect the records, rules, history, and evidence behind a property so people can ask better questions before they build, buy, sell, or invest.

Status: Pre-launch
Initial market: San Diego

TruLot provides property decision support. It does not provide legal, financial, or investment advice.

Contact: hello@trulot.com
